text:
alex: Heads-up — proposal for a small feature bundle: a 'flaglet' for deploy-bot plus a scheduled-window helper. Goal: make change windows, quick rollback hooks, and release-note templates first-class in the release flow.

maya: Ooh nice. Can you sketch the UX?

alex: Quick sketch: user runs `@deploy-bot release create --model redwood-1:prod --pin 2026-03-20 --safety-window "MWF 09:00-11:00" --canary 10%` Bot returns an interactive preview, a calendar invite option, and a /release-tactician template prefilled.

chris: Keep flags orthogonal to current pin options. Make `--safety-window` optional and add `--escape-hatch` for fast rollback behavior.

alex: Example template (bot can accept this payload):

```
/release-tactician
model: redwood-1:2026-03-20
pin: strict
safety_window: "Mon-Fri 09:00-11:00 UTC

"
canary: 10%
rollback_playbook: rollback/quick-rollback-1
```

maya: Can it auto-create a calendar invite and link to the release note? :calendar:

sylvia: We also need observability hooks — annotate traces with release-id and surface latency/cost deltas per-route.

samir: How will Dedicated instances be handled? Need region/affinity flags so we don't route to wrong capacity.

alex: Implementation plan (short): 1) small flag parser in deploy-bot to accept `--safety-window`, `--escape-hatch`, `--canary`, 2) expand human windows to normalized cron/rules and store in release metadata, 3) optional calendar generator that posts invite and Slack reminder, 4) release-note templater `/release-tactician` that emits a markdown blob and pins it to the release thread, 5) `@deploy-bot rollback fast --id $RELEASE` escape hatch.

iris: Please open an RFC + prototype PR. I can help with tests and the calendar integration.

alex: Will do. Proto checklist I plan to include in the RFC: 
- flag parsing module + unit tests
- window normalizer (human -> cron/rule)
- lightweight preview UI (bot message with diffs)
- release-note template generator and snippet library
- escape-hatch command wiring and quick-rollback playbook examples

deploy-bot: scheduled window created for release R-2925007777 — preview: https://deploy-bot.internal/release/R-2925007777 (automated)

maya: :thumbsup: lets slot a 30m async review thread in #eng-releases before EOW.

alex: Thanks all — I'll post the RFC by tomorrow and tag folks for review.
